you_should_know.title: Colorado governor requests disaster declaration from president, FEMA after Aspen Acres and Gold Mountain fires
you_should_know.description: Gov. Jared Polis requested a Major Disaster Declaration from President Trump after two different large-scale wildfires this summer destroyed hundreds of homes and disrupted local economies.

you_should_know.title: City of Aurora to launch Office of Public Safety Accountability
you_should_know.summary: After years under a consent decree, the City of Aurora, a large suburb 40 miles SE of Boulder, aims to keep oversight and accountability over APD, the Aurora Police Department, through a new Office of Public Safety Accountability.
